evidence.name: Screen field: How the icon fills its space
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How the icon fills its space" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How the icon fills its space
sections.description: Controls how the icon sits inside its box: Fit keeps the whole image visible and may leave a little padding, Fill keeps proportions but crops the edges, and Stretch fills the box and can distort the image. Use Fit for logos and glyphs — it's the safe default — unless you specifically want a cropped or stretched look.
